intro: In Moonbrook's northwestern corner, the schoolhouse stands abandoned under Defias occupation. A small graveyard lies behind the hall where Stalvan Mistmantle once taught local children.

p: Moonbrook's schoolhouse once welcomed children before ruin and bandits overtook the town. After Stalvan Mistmantle began tutoring local children, the mayor commissioned him to run a school. Students filled the hall in Moonbrook's brighter days, when the town prospered. Now outlaws occupy the abandoned building, and weathered headstones in its rear cemetery look out over Westfall's decline.
